title: formtxt

toolchain.linux_packages: libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev build-essential curl wget file libxdo-dev libssl-dev librsvg2-dev patchelf gstreamer1.0-plugins-base gstreamer1.0-plugins-good

build.windows:
call formtxt.bat install
call formtxt.bat install-desktop
call setup\desktop_build.bat %FORMCOMPILER_CONFIG_ARG%

catalog.name: FormTxt
catalog.summary: Documents on your own machine: paginated and pageless, with .docx and .odt round trips.

notes_for_owner: UNTESTED: formtxt had no build workflow, so no earlier run backs this entry. macOS and Linux follow the contract by hand: './formtxt desktop build' runs setup/desktop_build, which passes its arguments to 'tauri build'. On Windows 'formtxt.bat desktop build' forwards the word 'build' to setup\desktop_build.bat (which would run 'tauri build build --config ...'), so Windows calls setup\desktop_build.bat directly. bundle.targets is not set, so Tauri builds every bundle for the platform (dmg and app, deb, rpm, AppImage, msi, nsis); ./build_app, by contrast, builds the .app plus hdiutil dmg and the deb only and puts the Rust build outside the checkout. Not in formportal's products.json: the catalog entry is written from the README and tauri.conf.json. No bundle.macOS.minimumSystemVersion is set, so minimum_os is empty. No Tauri updater. macOS (formtxt 0.30.3): the engine is a PyInstaller onedir shipped as resource 'engine'; with APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY set, setup/freeze_backend signs every Mach-O in it with hardened runtime, a timestamp and src-tauri/entitlements.plist, and bundle.macOS.entitlements signs the app with the same file; neither has run in CI yet.
